speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan
text: asked	the Minister for Defence whether the National Day Parade Organising Committee will consider allowing greater priority for Pioneer Generation citizens when they apply to ballot for National Day Parade tickets.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Defence)
text: This is facilitated by the larger seating capacity of the National Stadium as well as the additional preview session.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Defence)
text: As it is, while the number of available tickets has increased, so will the number of applicants and it is inevitable that many will still be disappointed.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Defence)
text: So, the NDP Executive Committee (ExCo) endeavours to include as many Singaporeans as possible to experience NDP.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Defence)
text: As with previous NDPs, live telecast will also allow Singaporeans to watch the show at home.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Defence (Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman) (for the Minister for Defence)
text: Singaporeans can also look forward to participating in NDP through the engagement efforts which the ExCo will unveil in the coming months.

speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan (Mountbatten)
text: The feedback that I have is that many residents say that they have balloted many times for the NDP tickets but have never been successful.

speaker: Mr Lim Biow Chuan (Mountbatten)
text: Would the Ministry consider, for those who have never ever successfully balloted before for an NDP ticket, just to give them the opportunity to experience NDP live in the stadium, can they be given, say, triple or double chances, just to give them the experience?

speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
text: I think we all would like to give everybody the opportunity to experience NDP.

speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
text: It is going to be quite difficult to ascertain who has never ever had a chance to attend an NDP over the last 50 years of our Independence.

speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
text: It is going to be quite a difficult process to put in place in the first place.

speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
text: So, that is the best we can do to try to limit access of one group who has succeeded in one year, and possibly expand the opportunities for the others.

speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
text: But I think Mr Lim Biow Chuan would probably appreciate that it is going to be very difficult to first ascertain what is that frame of number of people who have "never ever".

speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
text: And everybody would probably say "I have never ever been successful" because we cannot possibly ascertain that.

speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
text: Because everyone who ballots or applies for tickets can apply for one, two, four or six tickets.

speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
text: So, the success is by one person, but six persons would have gone.

speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (Jurong)
text: It is a supplementary question, Mdm Speaker for the Senior Minister of State.

speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (Jurong)
text: Instead of one year of barring, that is, if you are successful in one year and you cannot benefit next year, why not extend it to three or five years, for that matter?

speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (Jurong)
text: Is this a system's constraint or our own constraint?

speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
text: I guess the argument would go either way.

speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
text: One would say, "Barring me for one year is sufficient.

speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
text: It is not that I am going to get the chance of getting successful one more time." But it is from feedback that we have put in place this system of barring them for one year.

speaker: Dr Mohamad Maliki Bin Osman
text: We can study it further; we can study the probability of one being successful even if we had blocked them for two or three years.
